item.title: Sabalenka blocks out noise to start US Open 'three-peat' bid with victory
item.description: Aryna Sabalenka blocks out the noise to overcome a tricky first-round test against Camila Osorio and begin her bid for a historic US Open "three-peat". Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Messi announces retirement from international soccer, says decision taken following father's death
item.description: "It was a decision that hurt - and still hurts deep down - but I understand that the time has come," Messi shared in a handwritten letter posted on Instagram. Fuente: The Jerusalem Post - International.
item.dc:creator: BY TOBIAS HOLCMAN

item.title: Kushner states regret over World Cup sell-off plan
item.description: Venture capitalist Joshua Kushner says he would not have got involved in Fifa president Gianni Infantino's scrapped plan to sell off stakes in the World Cup if he had known how the football world reacted. Publicado también por: BBC News - Business. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Bradley Barcola se incorpora al Liverpool procedente del PSG por una suma récord de USD166 millones
item.description: El Liverpool ha fichado con un contrato a largo plazo al delantero francés Bradley Barcola, procedente del París Saint-Germain, campeón de Europa, según anunció este lunes 31 de agosto el club de la Premier League, lo que lo convierte en la última incorporación estrella a su línea de ataque. Se estima que la astronómica suma de la transacción ronda los 120 millones de libras, lo que hace de Barcola el jugador más caro en salir de la liga francesa. Fuente: France 24 - Español.
item.dc:creator: France 24

item.title: Lionel Messi’s Retirement From Soccer Sparks Heartbreak Across Argentina
item.description: Lionel Messi’s retirement from the national soccer team, though widely expected, sparked fears of a diminished squad, and heartbreak over the departure of a national icon. Fuente: The New York Times - World.
item.dc:creator: Emma Bubola

item.title: Scotland beat Dutch by nine wickets to level series
item.description: Scotland level their one-day international series with the Netherlands at 1-1 after a thumping nine-wicket victory in a rain-affected match in Stirling. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: How Messi's decade of dominance almost never happened
item.description: Lionel Messi's decade of dominance with Argentina that almost never happened will go down as one of football's greatest ever stories. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Mareos, calambres y vómitos: Djokovic cae por primera vez en la ronda inicial del US Open ante Mariano Navone
item.description: Aquejado por los vómitos, los mareos y los calambres, la leyenda del tenis Novak Djokovic fue eliminado en la primera ronda del US Open por el argentino Mariano Navone. La caída temprana del serbio abre el interrogante sobre si el partido del domingo fue el último de Djokovic en el US Open o en cualquier otro Grand Slam. "No lo disfruté (...) creo que era obvio que me sentía fatal en la pista", confesó Djokovic al final del encuentro. Fuente: France 24 - Español.
item.dc:creator: AP

item.title: Touchline ban reduced for Rangers manager McInnes
item.description: Rangers manager Derek McInnes has a touchline ban reduced to two games, with two suspended, following an appeal against punishment for comments made on a last-gasp Celtic penalty. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Tottenham in talks to sign winger Mudryk on loan
item.description: Tottenham are in talks to sign Chelsea winger Mykhailo Mudryk on a season-long loan. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Elliott expected to join Valencia on loan
item.description: Liverpool midfielder Harvey Elliott is expected to join Valencia on loan for the rest of the season. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Goals, records, tears ... Messi's most iconic moments
item.description: As Lionel Messi retires from international football following the death of his father, BBC Sport looks back at some of his most iconic moments. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Soccer great Lionel Messi announces retirement from Argentina’s national team
item.description: “There isn’t much time left, and different chapters are coming to an end. This is one that hurts me a lot,” the 2022 World Cup winner wrote on Instagram. Fuente: The Washington Post - World.
item.dc:creator: Amy B Wang, Mariana Alfaro

item.title: Lionel Messi says he's retiring from playing internationally for Argentina
item.description: He said he wrote his retirement letter after the World Cup final in July, but waited to publish it because his father was facing health issues that eventually claimed his life. Fuente: NPR - World.
item.dc:creator: The Associated Press

item.title: Pakistan drop seven players and release head coach
item.description: Pakistan respond to their series defeat by England by taking the extraordinary step of dropping seven players, calling up five uncapped players and releasing their head coach. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: 'It hurts': Lionel Messi retires from Argentina national team after 21 years
item.description: Lionel Messi said on Monday he is retiring from international football after leading Argentina to a second successive World Cup final in July. Fuente: France 24 - English.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE 24

item.title: El astro del fútbol Lionel Messi se retira de la Selección de Argentina
item.description: El astro del fútbol argentino, Lionel Messi, anunció este lunes 31 de agosto que se retira de la selección de su país. En un emotivo mensaje difundido en sus redes sociales, el deportista de 39 años aseguró que ha sido una decisión meditada y difícil de tomar, pero señaló que “se van cerrando etapas”. Publicado también por: Marca. Fuente: France 24 - Español.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: Bombazo: Messi se retira de la selección argentina
item.description: El argentino anuncia oficialmente que abandona el combinado de su país: "Me vacié, ya no tengo más para dar" Fuente: Marca.
